description: Phase A expected-failure baseline for the DS-A-00 integration candidate I0 (S0 + P20 chain + T22 probes, reconciled contract). These are NOT Phase 0 legacy failures: they are the concrete authority-chain defects still open on I0 that later Phase A cards (A-01..A-06) must fix one by one. Consumed by run_tests.ps1 -BaselineExtra so the full matrix shows them as DECLARED Phase A expected failures while keeping each case status FAIL (never PASS, never skipped, never hidden). The Phase 0 file game_v17/tests/known_baseline_failures.json is NOT touched by Phase A.

evidence_provenance: Independently executed on I0 b9101c8 through the real product entry (main_menu -> v1_hud -> ShellBinder -> GameSession, DSH_BUILD=orbital_sim). Counts are deterministic across repeated runs. Every entry is a real, still-open authority-chain defect reproduced on I0, NOT an accepted regression.
notes: A0-T1 was REMOVED from this baseline on I0: the P20 chain fixes the sensor-geometry binding, so integration.a0_track_truth_authority now PASSES 45/0 on I0. Removal is backed by the DS-A-00 baseline run log, not by relaxing any assertion.

These entries must remain FAIL until the owning cards fix the underlying authority chain. Refreshing expected_pass/expected_fail is allowed only together with a runtime fix that legitimately changes the counts, in its own reviewed commit.
Phase 0 gate semantics are unchanged: -Gate phase0 never reads this file.
This file must never be merged into game_v17/tests/known_baseline_failures.json.

failures.reason: A0-T2 (reconciled contract): EntityCatalog is now verified complete and exact (7/7 entities x 6 fields by stable ID, 0 violations) and player-view anonymization already holds (no contact truth leak, no silent friend fallback, all side/identity/display sources declared). Four real gaps remain open on I0: (1) snapshot() exposes no explicit entity_catalog source block, so a synthetic view cannot declare where static fields come from; (2) CombatBallistics holds no EntityCatalog reference and (3) therefore resolves radius/rcs/has_pd from local defaults (RCS_DEFAULT_M2=800) instead of the catalog authority; (4) fused track rows leak the truth-only 'batch' field into the player view.
failures.defect_ref: A0 audit C2/C3 (metadata pipeline); Issue #2; reconciled by DS-A-00 contract table
failures.suggested_follow_up: DS-A-01 (catalog-sourced ballistics input, snapshot source declaration, track batch leak) -> then re-baseline

failures.reason: A0-T3 (reconciled contract): the raw-JSON numeric contract now PASSES (bus/event seq are finite integral values inside 0..2^53-1 and strictly increasing, judged by value semantics rather than by the JSON Variant type), and physics/world/track numeric roundtrip (<=1e-9), identification int config and save->load->save canonical equality also pass. Four real gaps remain open on I0: (a) the live HUD session save->load still fails with replay 'send_comms' no_route; (b) restored runtime event seq is a float instead of a real GDScript int (27 occurrences across the loaded bus); (c) the save payload carries no sensor_service runtime snapshot; (d) SensorService EMCON/radar state and full channel content are therefore lost on load (EMCON toggled to the opposite of its seed value before saving, 3 channels -> 1, 59 normalized content differences).
failures.defect_ref: A0 audit C4/C5 (event seq type drift, sensor runtime state not persisted); Issues #2/#4
failures.suggested_follow_up: DS-A-03 (EventBus restore + int seq) / DS-A-05 (sensor runtime persistence) / DS-A-06 (comms no_route) -> then re-baseline
